releases.title: Smarter issue tracking and a smoother welcome

items.text: Attach screenshots to issue reports and view them alongside the report details
Follow issue progress from submission and review through testing and completion
Explore release history in Settings with a dedicated timeline for app updates
Fixed a welcome-tour issue that could prevent returning readers from reaching the app
Added website analytics to help us understand visits and improve Reading Companion
Live reading companion with Hindi and Odia vocabulary support
Gems, memory, and chapter tracking saved entirely on-device
Progressive Web App install flow and update notifications ready
